units: Taan. 6ᵃ מ׳ בניסן the late rain (the malḳosh of the Bible) is the rain in Nisan.

<cite ref="Taanit 6a:7">Ib.</cite> (play on <he>מ̇ל̇ק̇וש̇</he>) <he>דבר שמ̇ל̇ ק̇ש̇יותן וכ׳</he> Rashi (ed. <he>קשיותיהן</he>) something which crushes the stiffneckedness of the Israelites (who humble themselves in prayer for rain); <he>דבר הממ̇ל̇א תבואה ב̇קש̇יה</he> something which fills the grain in its stalks; <he>דבר שיורד על המ̇ל̇ילות ועל הק̇ש̇ין</he> which falls upon both the ears and the stalks; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 863:6">Yalk. Deut. 863</cite>. Sifré Deut. s. 41; a. fr.
